title: Tape copying: Venus And Mars by Wings | 1975
content:
Sea-Saint Recording Studio, New Orleans
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

Wings’ final recording session in New Orleans took place on 21 February 1975. The next day copies were made of the multitrack tapes, in anticipation of further overdub sessions for the Venus And Mars album.

The band was not present on this day. Sound engineer Alan O’Duffy made safety copies of all the album 24-track masters, ahead of Wings’ recording sessions in Los Angeles.
